question: Who among the following was the first Sultan of Delhi to style himself as ‘Zil-i-Ilahi’?.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Balban**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Balban** was the first Sultan of Delhi to style himself as 'Zil-i-Ilahi' (Shadow of God).
 
• This title was adopted to enhance the prestige and divine status of the Sultan.
